_comment: Single-hop delegation token (RFC-AITP-0006). B (the delegator-of-record, the peer the issuing peer actually granted) delegates a subset of its grants to C, audience-bound to the issuing peer. On the wire the token is an opaque compact JWS (typ 'aitp-delegation+jwt') signed by B; it embeds the issuing peer's grant voucher verbatim as the 'voucher' claim — the voucher replaces the v0.1 grant_proof. Both tokens below are PLACEHOLDERS: header segments are real base64url of the protected headers, but payload and signature segments are human-readable stand-ins and will fail cryptographic verification. _decoded_claims shows the outer token's payload; _decoded_voucher_claims shows the embedded voucher's payload (it is the same voucher as examples/grant-voucher/voucher.json). For real, verifiable tokens see schemas/conformance/known-answer/signed-examples/delegation/.
